title: 第四章修炼第五章勒索第六章开元炼体术
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
徐翠娘失魂落魄地走了回来。
顾晦拿着毛巾在帮顾长青擦拭身体，院子外面非常安静，顾家的人应该都离开了。
“大郎，我来吧……”
徐翠娘走过来，从顾晦手里接过毛巾。
她的双眼无神，一脸茫然，几近麻木。
顾晦没有问她有没有从顾天北那里要到钱，虱子在和尚头上，明摆的事情。
顾天北若是愿意出钱。
先前杜郎中索要诊费的时候，他就会主动出手了，明明诊费不够，差了一两百钱，他都视而不见。
“娘，我出去一趟……”
顾晦朝低头给父亲擦身的徐翠娘说道。
“你！”
徐翠娘猛地抬头，双眼通红，一脸绝望。
“阿兄！”
顾瑜站在顾晦身侧，拉着他的衣角。
顾晦知道娘亲和妹妹为何如此，这是认为他老毛病犯了，家里遭逢巨变，依旧要跑出去和他的那些狐朋狗友厮混。
“娘，你放心，孩儿不到处跑，就在屋后的林子，练一练箭术和刀法，先前，孩儿遇到了罗大成，我已经给他说了，要顶替父亲加入打猎队……”
“前三个月，能够领取父亲的份额，到时候我看能不能把这些份额提前换取一些银钱，给父亲治病！”
顾晦解释了两句。
“大郎……”
徐翠娘唤了一声，嘴唇颤抖着，半晌说不出话来。

“娘，阿妹，你们放宽心，我一定会想办法治好父亲的腿，我们这个家，绝对垮不了！”
顾晦的声音并不慷慨激昂，却自有坚定。
“嗯，娘相信你！”
徐翠娘的声音带着哭腔，眼神又有了光。
之后，顾晦收拾了一番，拿起弓箭和猎刀在娘亲徐翠娘和小妹顾瑜的注视下走出了屋。
她们站在檐廊上，目送他穿过院子，来到院门前。
以前，顾长青出门进山去打猎，她们母女便会站在檐廊上，像像这样送行。
“娘，阿妹，好好照顾爹，天黑前我会回来……”
顾晦转过身，朝娘亲和小妹挥了挥手，之后，穿过院门，头也不回地走了出去。
……
顾家在镇子边缘。
院子的后面有一个带小树林的山坡，在半山腰的林子中间，有着一片空地。
此时，顾晦站在林间空地。
他抬头看了看天，天色依旧阴沉，雨就算落不下来，到了夜间多半也会侵袭大地。
狗日的天气！
狗日的命运啊！
顾晦低下头，望向前方，那里摆着一个草垛形成的箭靶，以前，这里是他跟随父亲学习箭术和刀法的地点，顾长青想要让他子承父业成为一个猎人。
打猎很凶险，每年都有猎人死在山里。
不过，高明的猎户收入也不错，顾长青就是靠着打猎的本事，攒下了这一份家业。
content_en:
Xu Cuiniang came back in despair.
Gu Hui was helping Gu Changqing wipe his body with a towel. It was very quiet outside the yard. Everyone in the Gu family must have left.
"Dalang, let me do it..."
Xu Cuiniang came over and took the towel from Gu Hui's hand.
Her eyes were dull, and her face was blank, almost numb.
Gu Hui didn't ask her if she had asked for money from Gu Tianbei. It was obvious that the lice were on the monk's head.
If Gu Tianbei is willing to pay.
Previously, when Dr. Du asked for the consultation fee, he would take the initiative. It was obvious that the consultation fee was not enough and the difference was one to two hundred dollars, but he turned a blind eye.
"Mom, I'm going out for a while..."
Gu Hui said to Xu Cuiniang who lowered her head to wipe her father's body.
"You!"
Xu Cuiniang raised her head suddenly, her eyes were red and she looked desperate.
"Brother!"
Gu Yu stood beside Gu Hui and pulled the corner of his clothes.
Gu Hui knew why his mother and sister were acting like this. She thought that he was relapsed into his old habit. Even though the family had undergone tremendous changes, he still wanted to run out and hang out with his bad friends.
"Mom, don't worry. The kid won't be running around. He will practice archery and sword skills in the woods behind the house. Earlier, the kid met Luo Dacheng. I have already told him that he will join the hunting team in his father's place..."
"In the first three months, I can receive my father's share. Then I will see if I can exchange these shares for some money in advance to treat my father's illness!"
Gu Hui explained two sentences.
"Dalang..."
Xu Cuiniang called out, her lips trembling, and she was speechless for a long time.
"Mom, sister, please relax, I will definitely find a way to cure my father's leg. Our family will never collapse!"
Gu Hui's voice was not impassioned, but firm.
"Well, mother believes in you!"
Xu Cuiniang's voice was filled with tears, and her eyes were bright again.
After that, Gu Hui tidied up, picked up his bow and hunting knife, and walked out of the house under the watchful eyes of his mother Xu Cuiniang and his younger sister Gu Yu.
They stood on the verandah and watched him cross the courtyard and come to the courtyard gate.
In the past, when Gu Changqing went out to hunt in the mountains, his mother and daughter would stand on the verandah and see him off like this.
"Mom, sister, take good care of dad. I will be back before dark..."
Gu Hui turned around, waved to his mother and little sister, then walked through the courtyard gate and walked out without looking back.
…
The Gu family is on the edge of town.
There is a hillside with a small forest behind the yard, and there is an open space in the middle of the forest halfway up the mountain.
At this time, Gu Hui stood in the forest clearing.
He looked up at the sky. It was still gloomy. Even if the rain didn't fall, it would probably hit the earth at night.
Dog day weather!
What a dog's fate!
Gu Hui lowered his head and looked ahead, where there was an arrow target made of haystacks. In the past, this was the place where he learned archery and sword skills from his father. Gu Changqing wanted his son to inherit his father's legacy and become a hunter.
Hunting is very dangerous, and hunters die in the mountains every year.
However, a skilled hunter can also earn a good income. Gu Changqing relied on his hunting skills to save this family fortune.
